field_by_field_justification.reason: The first clause establishes a classification/characterization, not required conduct.
Smallest sufficient definitional-classification predicate; illustrative, not a deterministic trigger.
No duty bearer or performer is asserted; the classified library is the topic, not an actor. This aligns with 37/39 Gold definition clauses having empty actors.

field_by_field_justification.value: is classified as a single service unit [37,75)
field_by_field_justification.reason: Non-empty definitional predicate, directly repairing the old E4 empty action. Presence is supported by 39/39 Gold definition clauses.
No antecedent event/state activates the classification.

field_by_field_justification.value: for the purposes of this bylaw [76,106)
field_by_field_justification.reason: A natural purpose/scope limit on the definitional predicate; included because it is semantic, not to fill a quota.
No case is removed from the classification.
The second clause explicitly equates a term with its meaning.
Explicit definition marker; retained to keep the narrow but valid old-E4 evidence coverage.
No duty bearer; term being defined is not an actor.

field_by_field_justification.value: means a facility open to the public [123,158)
field_by_field_justification.reason: Non-empty definitional predicate including necessary complement.
None are present; not all fields are filled artificially.

improvement_over_old_e4: The old E4 taught an empty definition action; every definition clause in this candidate has a non-empty action.
The old E4 demonstrated only explicit 'means'; the candidate adds a non-'means' classification definition.
The candidate retains one explicit 'means' clause, so the valid narrow means evidence is not lost.
The candidate adds a natural purpose/scope constraint, improving representativeness without making every field non-empty.
The candidate remains synthetic and contains no EStG wording or sample ID.
does_not_teach: No deterministic rule that 'classified as', 'means', or any other phrase always signals definition.
No resolution of the ambiguous apply/applies family or the shall-be-assumed / shall-be-determined pairs.
No rule that all stative, copular, or relational clauses are definitions.
No exact universal action-complement or condition/constraint boundary rule; the constraint boundary is only this sentence's evidence.
No deontic obligation example; other E examples already cover obligation, permission, and prohibition.
